parsed.rationale: The QRS is narrow with deep S waves in V1-V3 (V2 about 25 mm) and tall R waves in V5-V6 (V5 about 19 mm), so S in V2 plus R in V5 is well over 35 mm. The mild ST elevation in V1-V3 with lateral T-wave flattening fits LVH repolarization changes and does not meet STEMI criteria.
